about_the_game:
——This is a voyage about alchemy, emotion and self.

Synopsis:

"I" am "Ellixir", born in an alchemy family, living a secluded life with my father and brother Kunsheng.

On this day, brother Quintion, who had not been home for a long time, came home. After getting my father's permission, we started our voyage.

Along the way, I met Kuroo Ningen, Aibai, Cyrus, and Rudolf one by one. We created memories that I will never forget.

But they came because of alchemy after all, and they left because of alchemy. For what they lost, I angrily questioned and searched for the truth.

In the end, it turned out that Quintion and I were both sin bearers, and we were the origins of all kinds of reasons... It was said that I would experience freedom, but this Iris was like my cage.

Just like the paradox of the Ship of Theseus - is my existence real? Are my emotions real? What is my self...?

The real answer will eventually emerge in reality with infinite dreams.

Game Introduction:

This game is set in the World War II era, and is a visual novel for girls with the theme of Eastern and Western mysticism and metaphysics, including 5 male protagonists. The demo version contains 2 endings and a main line. The official version is expected to include 12 endings.

The narrative of this game is based on the heroine as the main perspective, including the secondary perspective of other characters, and some third-person perspectives.

Your choice will determine the fate and ending of the character.

Notes:

1. This work is purely fictional and has no connection with any real people, events, groups, or organizations.

2. Some texts and pictures contain descriptions of character wounds, bloodstains, babies, etc.

3. Some content contains descriptions of negative psychology and behavior of characters.

4. Some content contains related content such as mysticism and psychology, which have been re-created by the author. Please forgive any differences from reality.

5. The story is original to the author. Any similarity is purely coincidental.

6. The demo version takes about 1 hour to play, including 1 ending and 1 main line, and 17 CGs.

7. The official version takes about 6-8 hours to play, including 10 official endings, 2 additional endings, and 67 CGs.

8. The game does not contain any pornographic content, and the label content has nothing to do with the author.

Element warning:

Eastern and Western mysticism, metaphysics, blackening, imprisonment, suicide, uncleanness, resurrection

Mine clearance:

All male protagonists are older than female protagonists, but there is an ending where you can see the male protagonist's childhood appearance

No obvious standard for good or bad endings

All male protagonists have changes before and after

The female protagonist's personality is rational and cute in the early stage, and strong and emotionally intelligent in the later stage

Producer list:

Script, original painting, program uphandC to get started

Production tool gamecreator

Music Misakkil

Music material Demon King Soul Music Egg DOVA pixabay fiftysounds

cg thanks to Sanfen Quail Yuanou Raino

Script suggestions thanks to Sanfen Quail Xuanji

Related information guide author Xiaohongshu or B station @uphandC to get started

short_description: Ellixir's Dream is a single-player otome adventure where players, as an alchemist’s daughter, uncover their origins through choices and shape their fate with multiple endings.
